Title: TWD - Mercy for the Weak - April 8th, 2023

Messages.Author: lip
Messages.Body:
A friendly tournament, thanks @Vlad for organizing!

First round: Khazar - Nahkthoreb S&B - Gangrel Wall - Malkavian S&B - Kiasyd Nephandus

Resisted the Ministry bleeds for the whole game, proving the deck resilience. Managed a last minute lunge with Reckless (ousting both the Malks and Kiasyd, whom I couldn't pass because of Unmasking+Nephandus) and top-decked a Form of Mist to pass Khazar's Carlton with a Domain Challenge ousting the swarm.

Second round: Banu Haqim Royalty - Herald of Topheth - Gangrel Wall - Lutz Maris - Malkavian S&B

The bleed deck did its job ousting two preys, not too hard to control the 3-players game and get the win afterwards.

Finals seating dance:
Malkavian S&B - unnamed
Malkavian S&B - unnamed - Khazar
Malkavian S&B - Dmitra vote - unnamed - Khazar
Malkavian S&B - Dmitra vote - unnamed - Khazar - Gangrel Wall

The Malkavian ousted the Brujah vote first, Khazar opted to bounce the unnamed bleeds in the Brujah vote to avoid helping me. I help the unnamed get a VP out of the Khazar to keep the Malkavian out of an easy game win. Malkavian finally ousted the unnamed and ended up in a duel: in the end, the Malks couldn't get past the wall at all, but the short time left (17min) was just enough to get through the 18 pool of the Malkavian.

Deck Name: Gangrel Wall
Description:

Control the table, block stuff, and craft smart lunges. There are multiple lunge options:
- Bleed. 4/5 bleeds for one per turn can oust anyone. Faster if you get Club Illusion.
- Use the votes for a quick finish.
- Constant Revolution can sweep the table if you can protect it.
Low stealth, but Form of Mist + Form of the Bat can get through a surprising number of defenses.
